slowdown.note: No statement found on slowing frontier AI for safety; Axios reports he declined to support a full block on data center development, but that concerns data centers, not AI risk.

rsi.note: No statement found; he is not listed as a cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538).
